Bash(gh pr create --title "Add unit datasheet JSON schema, Battle Sisters Squad example, and Rust validator" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

- **`schemas/unit-datasheet.schema.json`** — JSON Schema \(draft 2020-12\) that declaratively covers everything in a wargaming unit datasheet: flexible per-game stat profiles, ranged/melee weapons with multi-mode sub-profiles, wargear options \(replace/add/remove/upgrade\) with per-unit/per-army/per-N-model limits and mutual exclusion, ability definitions, transport/leader mechanics, and composable constraint + condition expressions.
- **`data/40k/adepta-sororitas/battle-sisters-squad.json`** — Complete Warhammer 40K 10th Edition Battle Sisters Squad datasheet validating against the schema: full weapon roster, special-weapon per-5-model rules, Simulacrum Imperialis wargear option \(with `grants_keyword`\), Sister Superior upgrade options, and declarative constraint objects.
- **`src/datasheet.rs`** — Serde-derived Rust types that mirror every field of the schema; uses `serde_json::Value` for free-form stat blocks so the code stays game-system agnostic.
- **`src/validation.rs`** — Declarative validator that interprets the JSON constraint/option fields rather than hard-coding game logic. Covers: unit size \(fixed sizes / step / min-max\), wargear `max_per_unit` / `one_per_n_models` / `max_per_army` / `is_unique`, mutual exclusion pairs, and the `model_count_per_wargear` constraint with an inline formula parser. Includes a `calculate_points` helper and a full suite of unit tests.
- **`src/main.rs`** — CLI demo that loads the Battle Sisters datasheet at compile time and runs both a valid and an invalid selection through the validator.
- **`Cargo.toml`** — Rust package manifest \(`serde`, `serde_json`, `thiserror`\).
- **`.gitignore`** — Replaced Go template with Rust-appropriate ignores.

## Test plan

- [ ] `cargo test` — all unit tests in `validation.rs` pass \(valid sizes, invalid sizes, special-weapon limits, mutual exclusion, Simulacrum once/twice, points calculations\).
- [ ] `cargo run` — CLI demo prints valid selection as "OK" and invalid 3-meltagun selection with the correct constraint ID.
- [ ] Validate `battle-sisters-squad.json` against `schemas/unit-datasheet.schema.json` with any JSON Schema validator \(e.g. `ajv`\).
- [ ] Review schema `$defs` coverage for any planned game systems beyond 40K.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
